poll.question: Wesley sees the panther's eyes at the fern's edge near sleeping Mutu. Should he wake Chills to share the night watch, stand guard alone, or trust Mutu's fearlessness and

options.label: Wake him. Share it.
options.desc: Chills steadied you. Let him in. The bond holds the line tonight.

options.label: Guard alone. All night.
options.desc: Be the anchor Wesley is becoming. Prove you're steady. Stand your watch.

options.label: Trust Mutu. Sleep.
options.desc: The small fierce one refuses to fear. Maybe she knows something you don't.

in_play.label: Trust Mutu's instinct
in_play.desc: She knows the panther. Chills holds steady.
